ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): formatByExample keeps SUPPRESS as a slot with its bit; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true and SUPPRESS for 0 or false, in any case, and anything else ends the run with po:CREATEIF (ADR-0006 amended, F-37; fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: createIf over Tag in context Orders gives SUPPRESS, "", ""; Sku in context Order cuts after two slots. The first context, SUPPRESS, "", is the one the root's slot reads: one empty All. A SUPPRESS written as a value, or no cut, gives two.
